from_formats.title: From Formats
from_formats.description: Input format(s) to convert from. String or list of strings. Allowed values: docx, pptx, html, image, pdf, asciidoc, md, csv, xlsx, xml_uspto, xml_jats, xml_xbrl, mets_gbs, json_docling, audio, vtt, latex. Optional, defaults to all formats.

to_formats.title: To Formats
to_formats.description: Output format(s) to convert to. String or list of strings. Allowed values: md, json, yaml, html, html_split_page, text, doctags, vtt. Optional, defaults to Markdown.

image_export_mode.description: Image export mode for the document (in case of JSON, Markdown or HTML). Allowed values: placeholder, embedded, referenced. Optional, defaults to Embedded.

do_ocr.title: Do Ocr
do_ocr.description: If enabled, the bitmap content will be processed using OCR. Boolean. Optional, defaults to true

force_ocr.title: Force Ocr
force_ocr.description: If enabled, replace existing text with OCR-generated text over content. Boolean. Optional, defaults to false.

ocr_engine.title: Ocr Engine
ocr_engine.description: DEPRECATED: Use ocr_preset instead. The OCR engine to use. String.

ocr_lang.title: Ocr Lang
ocr_lang.description: List of languages used by the OCR engine. Note that each OCR engine has different values for the language names. String or list of strings. Optional, defaults to empty.

ocr_custom_config.title: Ocr Custom Config
ocr_custom_config.description: Custom configuration for OCR engine. Use this to specify engine-specific options beyond ocr_lang. Each OCR engine kind has its own configuration schema.

pdf_backend.description: The PDF backend to use. String. Allowed values: pypdfium2, docling_parse, threaded_docling_parse, dlparse_v1, dlparse_v2, dlparse_v4. Optional, defaults to docling_parse.

table_mode.description: Mode to use for table structure, String. Allowed values: fast, accurate. Optional, defaults to accurate.

table_cell_matching.title: Table Cell Matching
table_cell_matching.description: If true, matches table cells predictions back to PDF cells. Can break table output if PDF cells are merged across table columns. If false, let table structure model define the text cells, ignore PDF cells.

pipeline.description: Choose the pipeline to process PDF or image files.

page_range.title: Page Range
page_range.description: Only convert a range of pages. The page number starts at 1.

document_timeout.title: Document Timeout
document_timeout.description: The timeout for processing each document, in seconds.

abort_on_error.title: Abort On Error
abort_on_error.description: Abort on error if enabled. Boolean. Optional, defaults to false.

do_table_structure.title: Do Table Structure
do_table_structure.description: If enabled, the table structure will be extracted. Boolean. Optional, defaults to true.

include_images.title: Include Images
include_images.description: If enabled, images will be extracted from the document. Boolean. Optional, defaults to true.

images_scale.title: Images Scale
images_scale.description: Scale factor for images. Float. Optional, defaults to 2.0.

md_page_break_placeholder.title: Md Page Break Placeholder
md_page_break_placeholder.description: Add this placeholder between pages in the markdown output.

do_code_enrichment.title: Do Code Enrichment
do_code_enrichment.description: If enabled, perform OCR code enrichment. Boolean. Optional, defaults to false.

do_formula_enrichment.title: Do Formula Enrichment
do_formula_enrichment.description: If enabled, perform formula OCR, return LaTeX code. Boolean. Optional, defaults to false.

do_picture_classification.title: Do Picture Classification
do_picture_classification.description: If enabled, classify pictures in documents. Boolean. Optional, defaults to false.

do_chart_extraction.title: Do Chart Extraction
do_chart_extraction.description: If enabled, extract numeric data from charts. Boolean. Optional, defaults to false.

do_picture_description.title: Do Picture Description
do_picture_description.description: If enabled, describe pictures in documents. Boolean. Optional, defaults to false.

picture_description_area_threshold.title: Picture Description Area Threshold
picture_description_area_threshold.description: Minimum percentage of the area for a picture to be processed with the models.

picture_description_local.title: Picture Description Local
picture_description_local.description: DEPRECATED: Options for running a local vision-language model in the picture description. The parameters refer to a model hosted on Hugging Face. This parameter is mutually exclusive with picture_description_api. Please migrate to picture_description_preset or picture_description_custom_config.
examples: {"repo_id": "ibm-granite/granite-vision-3.2-2b", "prompt": "Describe this image in a few sentences.", "generation_config": {"max_new_tokens": 200, "do_sample": false}, "classification_allow": null, "classification_deny": null, "classification_min_confidence": 0.0}

{"repo_id": "HuggingFaceTB/SmolVLM-256M-Instruct", "prompt": "Describe this image in a few sentences.", "generation_config": {"max_new_tokens": 200, "do_sample": false}, "classification_allow": null, "classification_deny": null, "classification_min_confidence": 0.0}

picture_description_api.title: Picture Description Api
picture_description_api.description: DEPRECATED: API details for using a vision-language model in the picture description. This parameter is mutually exclusive with picture_description_local. Please migrate to picture_description_preset or picture_description_custom_config.
examples: {"url": "http://localhost:1234/v1/chat/completions", "headers": {}, "params": {"model": "granite3.2-vision:2b"}, "timeout": 20.0, "concurrency": 1, "prompt": "Describe this image in a few sentences.", "classification_allow": null, "classification_deny": null, "classification_min_confidence": 0.0}

{"url": "http://localhost:11434/v1/chat/completions", "headers": {}, "params": {"model": "granite3.2-vision:2b"}, "timeout": 20.0, "concurrency": 1, "prompt": "Describe this image in a few sentences.", "classification_allow": null, "classification_deny": null, "classification_min_confidence": 0.0}

vlm_pipeline_model.description: DEPRECATED: Preset of local and API models for the vlm pipeline. This parameter is mutually exclusive with vlm_pipeline_model_local and vlm_pipeline_model_api. Use the other options for more parameters. Please migrate to vlm_pipeline_preset or vlm_pipeline_custom_config.

vlm_pipeline_model_local.title: Vlm Pipeline Model Local
vlm_pipeline_model_local.description: DEPRECATED: Options for running a local vision-language model for the vlm pipeline. The parameters refer to a model hosted on Hugging Face. This parameter is mutually exclusive with vlm_pipeline_model_api and vlm_pipeline_model. Please migrate to vlm_pipeline_preset or vlm_pipeline_custom_config.
examples: {"repo_id": "ibm-granite/granite-vision-3.2-2b", "prompt": "Convert this page to markdown. Do not miss any text and only output the bare markdown!", "scale": 2.0, "response_format": "markdown", "inference_framework": "transformers", "transformers_model_type": "automodel-imagetexttotext", "extra_generation_config": {}, "temperature": 0.0}

vlm_pipeline_model_api.title: Vlm Pipeline Model Api
vlm_pipeline_model_api.description: DEPRECATED: API details for using a vision-language model for the vlm pipeline. This parameter is mutually exclusive with vlm_pipeline_model_local and vlm_pipeline_model. Please migrate to vlm_pipeline_preset or vlm_pipeline_custom_config.

vlm_pipeline_preset.title: Vlm Pipeline Preset
vlm_pipeline_preset.description: Preset ID to use (e.g., "default", "granite_docling"). Use "default" for stable, admin-controlled configuration.

vlm_pipeline_custom_config.title: Vlm Pipeline Custom Config
vlm_pipeline_custom_config.description: Custom VLM configuration including model spec and engine options. Only available if admin allows it. Must include 'model_spec' and 'engine_options'.

picture_description_custom_config.title: Picture Description Custom Config
picture_description_custom_config.description: Custom picture description configuration including model spec and engine options.

code_formula_custom_config.title: Code Formula Custom Config
code_formula_custom_config.description: Custom code/formula extraction configuration including model spec and engine options.

table_structure_preset.title: Table Structure Preset
table_structure_preset.description: Preset ID for table structure detection.

table_structure_custom_config.title: Table Structure Custom Config
table_structure_custom_config.description: Custom configuration for table structure model. Use this to specify a non-default kind with its options. The 'kind' field in the config dict determines which table structure implementation to use. If not specified, uses the default kind with preset configuration.

layout_custom_config.title: Layout Custom Config
layout_custom_config.description: Custom configuration for layout model. Use this to specify a non-default kind with its options. The 'kind' field in the config dict determines which layout implementation to use. If not specified, uses the default kind with preset configuration.

picture_classification_custom_config.title: Picture Classification Custom Config
picture_classification_custom_config.description: Custom configuration for picture classification. Use this to specify custom options for the picture classifier. The configuration should match DocumentPictureClassifierOptions schema.
